system.description:
Cramped slums and narrow lanes at the edge of the city. Rooms are small, rents are high, and help is hard to find. People get by on wit and elbows, and watch who is behind them.

Talent: one Might die to d10, one Finesse die to d10.

  • Alley Cunning. +2 Training in Guile.
  • Sharp Elbows. +2 Training in Prowess.
